\paragraph{Operating constraints and evidence.} 
% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-001
The payload must provide calibrated differential trapped-proton flux over 5–100 MeV, with energy-dependent response, background discrimination and uncertainty adequate for the approved tier products. No calibrated six-scintillator response; 5.4/5.5 MeV study cutoffs do not close 5 MeV.
% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-002
The payload science chain must enable a 5°×5° MMSC map: at least 70\% polygon coverage, 90\% core coverage, 3 independent passes/cell, at least 2 channels and fractional flux uncertainty ≤50\% per populated cell/channel. 92 geometric cells; eligible/core and independent-pass definitions unresolved.

% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-003
The payload science chain must enable the MSC 1°×1° atlas: at least 90\% detectable-cell coverage, 5 independent passes/cell, uncertainty ≤25\% in the two lowest operational channels, all operational channels, and monthly maps with >3σ changes flagged. Detailed criteria say all operational channels; summary specifies ≥4. Both retained pending reconciliation.
% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-004
The payload science chain must enable 0.5°×0.5° EMSC products: ≥95\% of cells above AP9 1\%-of-mission-peak eligibility, 5 independent passes/cell, ≥3 channels, ≤10\% uncertainty in one channel and ≤15\% in every other operational channel. Primary-map ≤15\% rule and two 9–10 month submaps remain binding; required-G percentiles are not compliance.

% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-005
The payload mechanical/readout interface must conform to five longitudinal 6×6×14 mm blocks, a 6×6×2 mm front element and eleven SiPMs, with no silicon entrance stage. Geometry arithmetic/configuration checked; package/material/optics unselected.
% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-006
The payload timing interface must distinguish 20 ns ASIC shaping from the 200 ns coincidence target and ≥250 ns allowance (about 300 ns preferred); it must not assign these values as detector dead time. Separate config fields; qualified latency/dead time remain unknown.

% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-007
The payload readout must handle the declared mixed-species peak/burst trigger envelope without unflagged saturation, pileup, loss or counter overflow. Rate, loss and dead-time allocations remain open allocations. Proton-only400 Hz is not a bound; electron incident proxies can dominate.
% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-008
The payload response allocation must provide energy-dependent effective geometric factor and livetime sufficient for tier exposure/precision, including background and reconstruction uncertainty. Required acceptance values remain conditional on verified exposure. Broad-band G95≈0.36–0.50 cm² sr at10\% is ideal counting arithmetic, not achieved G.

% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-009
The payload science accounting must conserve counts across acquisition time and effective energy-bin boundaries, retain valid zero-count exposure, and carry livetime, background and calibration identity into accumulated cell/channel uncertainty. Reference conservation tests pass; legacy expected counts are not reconstructed events.
% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-010
The payload reference science format must define entry/exit timestamps, latitude/longitude/altitude, 64 provisional uint32 bins, sequence, 16-bit mode/health marker and CRC in 292 bytes excluding radio framing. Codec/schema and CRC/count tests support the logical interface.

% Shared source: ANT-PLD-FR-011
The payload scheduler must prefer 3 readings per eligible visit, seek 2 when feasible and retain 1 when necessary, with nonoverlapping valid intervals, correct cell assignment and conserved counts/exposure; no arbitrary minimum duration or count is imposed. Reference partitions tested; exact crossings and hardware boundaries unknown.

\paragraph{Feasibility assessment.} The longitudinal scintillators and distributed SiPM readout define an inspectable payload concept; the record codec has bounded software evidence. Neither the stopping response nor effective geometric acceptance is calibrated. Material/optical interfaces, mixed-species trigger demand and qualified channels are concept-level feasibility gaps, not details that can be waived until qualification. Section 1 remains authoritative: MMSC uses at least two channels; MSC retains all operational channels and the comparison table's at-least-four statement pending reconciliation; EMSC retains its primary-map ≤15\% rule, minimum three channels and two 9–10 month sub-period maps. The counting examples N≈4 and N≥16 do not replace full uncertainty or create a new confidence level.
